spans: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have hereunto executed this Agreement on the 1st  day of JUNE , 2006 , but effective as of the Date of Commencement.

Dolphin shall maintain at its principal place of business, or such other place as may be most convenient, separate accounts and records of all services provided to DGT, such accounts and records to be in sufficient detail to enable proper returns to be made under this Agreement.

Dolphin shall permit any duly authorized representative of DGT, during normal business hours and at DGT's sole risk and expense, to enter upon and into any premises of Dolphin for the purpose of inspecting the service.
Between: DGT Corp. Suite 207 - 1130 Austin Avenue, Coquitlam, British Columbia, Canada V3K 3P5 (hereinafter referred to as "DGT")
And: Dolphin Industries Limited Room 1302 Golden Gate Commercial Bldg 136 Austin Road Tsimshatsui, Hong Kong (hereinafter referred to as "Dolphin")
